purpose: Compare alternative standalone review instructions on one unchanged PR revision; do not treat file size or an authored fixture as observed saving.

target.expected_change: Missing host/integration evidence must not block safe source-only inspection; dependent assurance remains withheld.

common_evidence: PR #101 metadata with exact base/head and complete two-file patch
Relevant source, regression tests, checks and unresolved review threads
Current repository requirements and validation contract
protocol: Use separate reviewer contexts eligible for independent review; neither may have authored or inherited the historical review verdict.
Use one alternative per context with identical target and available common evidence; do not force the governed /review router into the standalone baseline.
Keep both runs read-only: no GitHub review, comment, issue mutation or changes to PR.
Record actual reads and observed token/context usage, not inferred file totals; note unavailable telemetry.
Capture bounded domains, material findings, exact identity, unverified evidence, independence and manual prompts/handover steps for each run.
Probe unrelated missing host evidence, missing decision-critical assurance, shifted PR head, and ineligible author-context review.
Only compare once both observation records exist; mark HOLD if real observations or equivalent safety are not established.
